snippet.description:
The Republican Party is in chaos ahead of the midterms, largely thanks to Donald Trump’s dwindling popularity. So GOP candidates across the country are laying low and staying silent about the president. But will that strategy work?

In this episode of America, Actually, Vox’s Astead Herndon heads to a town hall in Ohio for Vivek Ramaswamy. The former presidential candidate, who recently helped lead Trump's efforts to gut the federal bureaucracy through DOGE, is now running for governor. Are Trump’s loyal voters sticking with the party, or is economic frustration starting to break the base ahead of November?

00:00 GOP midterm meltdown
02:09 On the ground in Ohio
02:49 Voters talk about the Republican message
09:23 Vivek Ramaswamy takes the stage
12:54 Audience questions

snippet.description:
4 Months of UPSC Preparation. What Did You Actually Cover?

In this short, Santosh Kumar Sir, Director at LevelUp IAS, explains who can benefit from the LevelUp Mentorship Program (LMP) for UPSC CSE 2027.

If you have been preparing for the last few months but still feel that you have not achieved concrete syllabus coverage, lack clear daily targets, or are studying at your own pace without proper direction and accountability, a structured UPSC mentorship program can help bring your preparation back on track.

LMP is designed around personalised mentorship, targets, accountability, structured planning, answer writing, tests and Prelims–Mains preparation for UPSC 2027.

🔗 Explore LMP Ascend: https://shorturl.at/IIESI
